bounded_discovery_context.method: Targeted search and direct inspection of revised Anadolu article 4140045; compared with 23 authenticated prior November 26–27 heartbeats.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Newly recovered three-person injury report naming Al-Maslakh and Hamad City; original article was previously logged for a woman injured south of Khan Younis and six injured in Al-Rimal. Updated text separately mentions the earlier woman.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Exact update and event times unknown; potential overlap with earlier woman or child injury reports cannot be excluded. Do not add counts. No independent corroboration or production comparison.
